description: Drinkwaterwingebieden (Omgevingsvisie 2016-2020) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.provinciegroningen.nl. This stock contains drinking water extraction areas as defined in the Environmental Vision for the Province of Groningen 2016-2020. In water catchment areas, in principle, only activities that are directly or indirectly related to the production of drinking water are permitted. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water catchment areas (Environmental Vision 2016-2020)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2017-11-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
